prompt:
script: Aaj hum ek aisi duniya mein jee rahe hain jahan technology har second badal rahi hai. Jo cheezein kuch saal pehle sirf science fiction movies mein dekhi jaati thi, aaj woh hamari real life ka hissa ban chuki hain.

Artificial Intelligence, yaani AI, ab sirf computers tak mehdood nahi rahi. Yeh hamare phones, cars, hospitals, offices aur hatta ke hamari daily life mein bhi shamil ho chuki h

parts.title: Sci-Fi Becomes Reality
parts.brief: A dynamic montage contrasts classic science fiction cinema with today's real-world robotics and smart devices. The viewer learns how rapidly theoretical technological dreams have transformed into ordinary domestic utilities. This sets an engaging hook by connecting past imagination to present reality.

script.text: Aaj hum ek aisi duniya mein jee rahe hain jahan technology har second badal rahi hai.
Jo cheezein kuch saal pehle sirf science fiction movies mein dekhi jaati thi...
...aaj woh hamari real life ka hissa ban chuki hain.
Artificial Intelligence, yaani AI, ab sirf computers tak mehdood nahi rahi.

layers.text: From movie screens to everyday domestic tools
Not just confined to computers anymore...
AI is now actively shaping real physical life...

parts.title: The Velocity of Modern Change
parts.brief: Kinetic infographics track the exponential acceleration of computing power from room-sized mainframes to modern microprocessors. The viewer discovers how technological evolution has compressed centuries of progress into single decades. This builds upon the opening hook by explaining the mathematical engine behind modern advancement.

parts.title: Demystifying Artificial Intelligence
parts.brief: Sleek 3D motion graphics visualize neural networks and machine learning models processing massive data streams. The viewer learns that modern AI is essentially sophisticated pattern recognition rather than conscious sci-fi machinery. This transitions the narrative from broad technological growth to the specific mechanics of AI.

parts.title: Intelligence in Your Pocket
parts.brief: Close-up visuals demonstrate facial unlocking, predictive text suggestions, and real-time computational photography on modern smartphones. The viewer realizes that consumer pocket devices deploy billions of micro-decisions daily to streamline communication. This grounds the abstract algorithms from the previous section into relatable personal habits.

parts.title: Autonomous Mobility: Roads and Skies
parts.brief: Visuals transition to LiDAR point-cloud perspectives, self-driving electric vehicles, and intelligent traffic control grids. The viewer learns how autonomous systems interpret chaotic physical environments in milliseconds to transport goods and passengers safely. This scales AI's presence from handheld consumer devices to city-wide transportation infrastructures.

parts.title: Revolution in Healthcare and Diagnosis
parts.brief: The screen reveals high-resolution radiological scans being analyzed by diagnostic AI alongside robotic surgical assists. The viewer learns how algorithms detect malignancies earlier than the human eye and accelerate lifesaving drug discovery. This elevates the stakes from practical convenience to preserving human life.

parts.title: The Rewired Workplace
parts.brief: Footage depicts corporate offices and design studios leveraging generative assistants for code generation, data analytics, and graphic synthesis. The viewer observes how routine white-collar tasks are automated, shifting employee focus toward strategic problem-solving. This connects healthcare innovation to the broader disruption occurring across global professional industries.

parts.title: The Friction Points: Ethics and Disruption
parts.brief: Moody lighting frames data centers, biometric monitoring grids, and newspaper headlines concerning economic displacement. The viewer confronts critical challenges surrounding algorithmic bias, individual privacy loss, and labor market volatility. This introduces essential dramatic tension into the documentary after successive showcases of technological achievement.

parts.title: The Human Equation: Symbiosis Over Replacement
parts.brief: Warm visual tones showcase educators, craftspeople, and researchers collaborating alongside intelligent machines. The viewer learns that human empathy, critical judgment, and emotional nuance remain indispensable counterparts to mechanical computation. This directly answers the anxiety raised in the previous section by defining a healthy collaborative framework.

parts.title: The Horizon: Shaping the Next Epoch
parts.brief: Panoramic footage shows smart green cities, clean energy grids, and deep space telemetry guided by ethical computation. The viewer reflects on the fundamental truth that humanity ultimately dictates how these transformative tools are deployed. This delivers a powerful, forward-looking conclusion to the entire transformative arc.
